column1: # Quick task 260930-eo3 — "RUN ADDS ON THESE PRODUCTS"
# Operator-supplied ad shortlist, 2026-09-30. Format: name<TAB>part number.
# Lines starting with # are ignored, as are blank lines.
# Transcribed verbatim from the supplied spreadsheet. Two things worth knowing
# before reading a report built from it:
#   * "Lenovo ThinkSmart PC Gen 2 - Teams" and "Lenovo ThinkSmart Core Gen 2 -
#     NUC PC" carry the SAME part number (12X2S0000F). One of them is wrong in
#     the source. The report resolves both to the same product and says so
#     rather than quietly showing a duplicate row.
#   * These are MANUFACTURER part numbers. Our products.sku may differ, so the
#     command reports how each row matched (exact / normalised / not found) —
#     a "not found" is a catalogue gap, not a pricing verdict.
Logitech Rally Bar Mini + Tap IP
Logitech Teams Base Bundle - NUC + TAP
Cisco Webex Room Bar + Table Navigator
Lenovo ThinkSmart Core Gen 2 - NUC PC
